profile.primaryRole: Senior Digital Transformation & Product Strategy Executive in Healthcare Technology
profile.summary: Geetanjali Arora is a seasoned healthcare technology executive with 15+ years of leadership spanning digital transformation, product portfolio management, and agile delivery at companies including Pfizer and Bio Reference Laboratories. She brings deep expertise in SaaS product strategy, EHR platforms, AI-driven initiatives, and large-scale program governance with a proven track record of driving revenue growth, operational efficiency, and direct-to-consumer digital launches. Her background bridges clinical/lab informatics, enterprise software, and commercial digital strategy, making her a strong fit for VP or Senior Director roles at the intersection of healthcare and technology.
